{{Header Nav|game=Red Dead Redemption}}
There are 58 achievements for the Xbox 360, including twelve secret ones and ten from DLC, worth {{G|1,100}}. There are 59 trophies for the PlayStation 3, including 12 secret ones and ten from DLC, consisting of one {{platinum}}, two {{gold}}, 12 {{silver}} and 44 {{bronze}}.
